Nothing is built or written yet, so this message needs no actions.

Here is what I understand so far. The garden lends seed packets, and you want a clearer record of what goes out and what comes back. Today that record is a shared spreadsheet with five columns: Seed, Packets, Borrower, Date out and Date back.

One thing stands out. About a third of the Date back cells are empty. That gap can mean different things, and each one points to a different tool:

- People still have the seeds and are late.
- People returned them, but nobody wrote it down.
- Nothing was meant to come back, because the seeds went into the ground.

Many seed libraries work the third way. A borrower plants the packet, then months later returns new seed saved from the harvest. That seed is often a different amount, and sometimes a different variety. If your library works like this, "came back" is not the same packet coming home. It is a second, separate event, and the spreadsheet has no good place to record it.

Please correct anything I have wrong.

When someone brings seeds back to your library, what are they usually bringing?
